Commentary.Commentary: South Africa began well but never had the Kiwis under pressure despite the slow nature of the wicket. Dwaine Pretorius was the best bowler for them, taking 2/40 in his ten as the rest of the bowlers struggled for consistency. They have a tough target to chase and the hosts will back their bowling attack to defend this total. It promises to be an exciting chase, do join us in a while for it.

A top batting effort by the Kiwis on this slowish wicket to set up a competitive chase for the Proteas. They didn't begin in a promising manner as Latham's poor run continued but Williamson came in and along with Brownlie saw off the juice in the pitch. Brownlie didn't last long though and it was the experienced pair of Kane and Ross who had to do the repair job. The duo added 104 for the third wicket before the Kiwi skipper threw it away for 69. Taylor though did not miss out and registered his 17th ODI ton, also being the fastest to 6,000 ODI runs for NZ. He got good support from Neesham who hit a 57-ball 71.

FOUR! Ross Taylor, you beauty! He now has his 17th ODI ton, the most for any player from New Zealand! Fuller outside off, Taylor gets across and drills it hard through extra cover for a boundary. He is pumped up, he was not in best of form and has made his presence felt with a brilliantly paced ton. He celebrates in his own unique way, with his tongue sticking out. New Zealand finish with 289/4!

David Miller, what an effort! Fuller outside off, Taylor clubs it towards wide long on. That looks to be going to hand as David Miller is at long on waiting for it, going towards his right. He gets to it, dives full stretch and gets hold of the ball. He though spots himself being too close to the fence and looks to pull the ball back in play. He ends up pushing it too far from him and cannot take the catch. Two runs taken but that was some effort from Miller. Taylor is on 98, will he get to his ton?
Length ball angling into the body, clipped through mid-wicket for a single by Neesham. Gives strike to Ross Taylor!
FOUR! Put away! Fuller length angling into the stumps, Neesham gets under it and swings it down the ground for a boundary.
Fuller outside off, Neesham goes for the reverse paddle but misses. Then looks for a bye to give Ross the strike. De Kock has a shy at the striker's end but misses.
Full toss from Parnell, Taylor smashes it through covers for a single. Moves onto 96!
Length ball outside off, Taylor cuts it hard towards point but not in the gap. A single taken.
Length ball from Andile, Neesham mistimes his drag towards mid on for a single.
Length outside off, Taylor swings it through mid-wicket for a single. He slips at the non-striker's end and that prevents the second.
Length outside off, Neesham smashes it towards long off for a single.
FOUR! Neesham gets one in the arc on the stumps and puts it away with a whip through wide mid on for a boundary.
Shorter length ball, slower in pace, Taylor has to wait ages for it to arrive, gets it towards short third man for a single.
Fuller on the stumps, nudged through the on side for a brace.
100-run stand up between Taylor and Neesham.
Neesham tucks it towards square leg and takes a couple of runs.

Dropped! Faf is the culprit! Parnell bowls it on a length outside leg, Neesham looks to swing it over mid-wicket. Faf coming in from deep mid-wicket, dives forward but cannot hold onto the chance. That should have been taken.
Fuller outside off, Taylor gets it down to third man for a single.
Too full outside off, Neesham digs it out towards short third man for a single.
Full toss on the stumps, Neesham swings it through mid-wicket for a couple of runs.
Wayne Parnell is back on for his final spell.

FOUR! Poor ball and punished! Short and wide outside off, with no third man in place, Taylor is happy to slash at it. He gets it over the two fielders at backward point and short third man for a boundary.
Length outside off, Neesham comes down hard on it but finds AB de Villiers at mid off who does not have a shy at the stumps at the non-striker's end.
Shorter outside off, Taylor gets on top of it and pulls it through mid-wicket for a single.
Full outside off, Taylor drives it through covers for another brace. This is a superb piece of batting.
FOUR! Crashed! Fuller outside off, Taylor does not miss out and crashes it through the cover region for a boundary. That really sped to the ropes.
3rd ODI fifty for Jimmy Neesham.
FIFTY! Well played, Neesham! Very full outside off, Neesham squirts it towards point for a quick single to bring up his fifty.
Andile Phehlukwayo comes back into the attack.
On a length shaping in, Neesham lofts it down to long on and gets a run for it to retain strike.

Fullish delivery well outside off, Taylor looks to scoop it over the keeper's head by moving a long way across but gets an inside edge. The ball goes back to hit his boots and rolls to the off side. Single taken!
Fullish delivery just outside off, Jimmy shuffles across and looks to get underneath it but is not quite able to do so. Swings it across to long on for a run.
Full length ball outside off, drilled to deep cover for a single.

Dwaine steams in and hurls in a terrific yorker on middle, Neesham backs away and blocks it down the pitch and sets off for a run. Morris is quick to get across and scores a direct hit at the striker's end but Taylor is safely in.
Bowls a full toss on off, Neesham hits it through widish mid on and gets two runs for doing so.
Dwaine Pretorius is brought back into the attack.
Angling into the stumps, Taylor heaves it through backward square leg for a couple of runs. That came off the inner half of the bat.
Shorter outside off, Taylor again shapes to pull but is beaten all ends up.
WIDE! Sprays it down the leg side for a huge wide. The umpire signals it a wide.
FOUR! Easy pickings! Slanting on the pads, Taylor gets across a touch and deflects it down into the fine leg fence for a boundary.
Length ball on off, Neesham swings it through mid-wicket for a single.
Fuller in length on off, Taylor drills it through mid on for a single.
Shorter in length but on leg, Taylor looks to pull it, keeping it down but misses. The umpire signals it one for the over.
Floats it on off, Taylor gets over it and turns it through square leg for another single. End of Tahir's spell.
Neesham works it through mid-wicket for a single.
Floats it outside off, Taylor flays it through point for a single.
Lands it on off, Neesham heaves it through backward square leg for a single.
WIDE! Sprays it down the leg side, Neesham lets it go. A wide is signaled.
Neesham kneels down and slog sweeps it through mid-wicket for a couple of runs.
FOUR! Top shot! Floats it outside off, Neesham gets under it and dispatches it down the ground for a boundary. Brilliant start to the over.
Bowls it too full outside off, Neesham just about digs it out in time towards the off side for a single.
Fuller outside off, Neesham hits it towards extra cover from his crease.
50-run stand up between Taylor and Neesham.
Short outside off, Neesham mistimes his punch through covers for a brace.
FOUR! Crunched! Shorter outside off, Neesham picks it early and pummels it through square leg for a boundary.
Drifting on the pads, worked through square leg for a single.
Ross Taylor makes room for himself to hit through the off side, Morris spots it and follows him. Taylor is early into his shot and is beaten.
Flatter on off, worked through mid-wicket. Taylor wants the second but Neesham slips at the striker's end and hence cannot take the second.
Taylor covers the line on this one and works it to mid-wicket.
Dropped? Tough chance! Shorter outside off, Neesham looks to cut but gets a bottom edge that hits de Kock on his pads and runs down to third man. A single taken.
Flatter on the stumps, Taylor clips it through square leg for a single.
Floats it on the stumps, Neesham works it towards mid-wicket for a single.
FOUR! Crashed! Fuller outside off, Neesham cracks it through covers for a superb boundary. That was nicely hit.
Imran Tahir comes back into the attack.
Neesham swings at this length ball on off, gets it towards mid on for a single.
Length ball outside off, Neesham unfurls a punchy drive but finds the cover-point fielder.
Shorter outside off, Neesham cuts it but finds the backward point fielder.
Length ball outside off, dabbed past point for a single.
Fuller in length on the stumps, Taylor fails to clip it through. There is a slight appeal for lbw but not given as it was sliding down leg.
On a length around off, Taylor watches it closely and defends it back down the wicket.
Chris Morris comes back for a bowl.
The umpire signals the start of the final Powerplay. Five fielders are now allowed outside the circle.
Fuller on off, Neesham is right behind this one and defends it.
Flatter on the stumps, nudged towards backward square leg for a single. 200 up for the home side!
Drives it to mid on from his crease.
Shorter on the stumps, Neesham goes back and cuts it towards point for a single.
Flatter on off, clipped through wide mid on for a single.
Floats it on the stumps, Neesham comes down and mistimes his heave through mid on for a single.
Back of a length outside off, Taylor is taken back by the inward movement, he almost ends up pushing it towards the point fielder who almost gets to it coming forward.
Length ball angling into the body, Neesham works it through square leg for a single.
Taylor drives this length ball to the right of the bowler for a single.
Fuller outside off, Neesham drives it through mid off for a quick single. There is a shy from AB de Villiers at mid off at the non-striker's end but misses.
Length ball on the stumps, tucked down to fine leg for a single.
Length ball from Dwaine, Taylor taps it towards point and again looks for a single but it is not on.
FOUR! Flayed! Flatter outside off, Neesham throws his bat at it and gets it between backward point and short third man for a boundary.
Shorter outside off, Taylor goes back and cuts it to deep point for a single.
Goes back and works it through mid-wicket for a single.
Shorter in length, Neesham punches it on the bounce to the bowler.
Turns it through mid-wicket for a single.

Not out! Close call! Flatter outside off, Taylor looks to clip it through but is rapped on his pads. The players appeal long and hard but the umpire stays put. Duminy is confident and goes for the review. Replays confirm there was no bat there.Time for the Ball Tracker, it shows the impact was in-line but it was clipping the leg stump and hence the on-field call stays. Taylor was all smiles when he was given not out but replays show it could have gone either ways. South Africa lose their only review.
An lbw appeal against Taylor is referred upstairs by South Africa.
Fuller outside off, Neesham mistimes his drive towards covers.
Shorter length angling on the stumps, pulled down to fine leg for a single.
Length ball outside off, Taylor taps it towards point and looks for a single but is sent back.
Another one angling on the stumps, Neesham nudges it through backward square leg for a single.
Angles it on a length, Neesham defends it off the inside half of the bat onto his pads and then the ball rolls towards the off side.
Bowls it outside off on a length, Neesham looks to dab it down to third man but is beaten by the lack of pace on it.
Shorter outside off, Neesham punches it through cover-point for a single.
Shorter on off, Neesham goes back and pulls it through mid-wicket for a couple of runs.
Taps it towards covers for a quick single.
EDGED! Shorter outside off, Ross looks to cut it through but gets it off the edge just past the gloves of the keeper towards short third man.
Shorter on the stumps, Neesham stays back and punches it through mid on for a single.
Flatter on middle, Taylor tucks it through square leg for a single.
JP Duminy is called in for a bowl.
Length ball outside off, Taylor pushes it towards mid off from his crease and takes a quick single.
Outside off, Neesham dabs it behind backward point for a single.
WIDE! Slants this one down the leg side on a length, Neesham fails to clip it.
Shorter outside off, Taylor goes for the pull but gets a top edge through mid-wicket for a single.
Outside off on a length, Neesham stands in his crease and taps it towards covers. Taylor calls him through for a single and they complete it with ease.
Neesham stays in his crease and keeps this length ball out.
Fuller on off, Neesham plays it back down the wicket to the bowler who goes to his left and stops the ball.
Shorter outside off, Neesham drags it through mid-wicket for a single.
Drifts it on the pads, Neesham works it through square leg for a couple of runs.
Outside off on a length, Neesham looks to swing it through the on side but finds mid on.
On a fuller length on off, Neesham stays back and angles it towards the on side.
Fuller in length on the stumps, nudged down to fine leg for a single.
Shorter in length around off, Taylor pulls it towards square leg rolling his wrists over it.
Andile Phehlukwayo comes back for a bowl.
Angles it on the stumps, worked through mid-wicket for a couple of runs to get off the mark.
On a length on off, Neesham defends it with a half stride.
Jimmy Neesham is the new man in.

OUT! Soft dismissal! Shorter outside off, Broom goes for the cut shot but fails to keep it down. JP Duminy at point has nothing to worry about as he pouches a simple catch. New Zealand need to ensure there is no collapse here.
Broom tucks this length ball towards the leg side from his crease.
Around off on a length, Broom defends it from his crease with a late dab.
On a length on off, Taylor taps it towards square leg for a single.
Dwaine Pretorius is back into the attack.
Time for Drinks.
Back of a length outside off, bounces more on Broom who does well to keep it down in front of him.
Angles it on off, Broom tucks this one towards square leg off his crease.
Shorter length ball from Morris, Taylor rolls his wrists over it and gets it towards square leg, where the fielder gets a hand to it and deflects it towards mid-wicket for a single.
On a length on off, Taylor defends it watchfully.
A tad short outside off, Broom flashes it through point for a single.
Defends this length ball off his back foot.
6000 ODI runs for Ross Taylor!
33rd ODI fifty for Ross Taylor!
FOUR! Shot! Tahir drags it short and wide outside off, Ross camps back and cuts it hard through backward point and the ball races to the fence. It has been a well constructed half century for Taylor.
Tahir slips in the googly outside off, Broom comes forward to counter the spin but gets it off the inner half towards square leg. Single taken!
The batsman has nudged the ball fine down the leg side. They pick up a single.
Neil Broom is the new man in.

OUT! End of a brilliant knock from the Kiwi skipper and the 104-run stand comes to an end! Tahir bowls a tossed up delivery in line of the stumps, Williamson kneels and looks to slog sweep it but ends up miscuing it towards long on. Phehlukwayo who is stationed in the deep runs in front and pouches it safely. South Africa will be happy to see the back of Williamson. It's a timely breakthrough for the visitors, Kane was looking dangerous out there.
Tossed up delivery in line of the stumps, Williamson comes down the track and chips it nicely over mid-wicket for a couple.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.

Similar length ball well outside off, Taylor looks to punch it through covers but gets it from the outer half of the bat towards third man. Taylor is rushing back for the second but there is a throw from the deep to the keeper who flicks the bails off. Taylor seems to be in as the run out appeal is referred upstairs. Replays confirm that he is safe.
There is a run out appeal against Taylor which is referred upstairs. Looks not out.
100-run stand up between Ross Taylor and Kane Williamson!
Shortish and wide outside off, cut through backward point for two runs.
Back of a length outside off, glided to third man for a single.
Fuller length ball in line of the stumps, Ross clips it through mid-wicket for a run.
Short of a length outside off, Williamson makes room and places it through the gully region. Single taken!

Good running between the wickets! Fullish delivery outside off, Williamson drives it off the inner half of the bat towards mid on and immediately calls for a single. The ball beats the diving fielder and Williamson has enough time to come back for the second run.
Loopy ball around off, Taylor pushes it back to Tahir.
Not quite where he intended! Shorter delivery outside off, Taylor rocks back to cut it through backward square leg but gets it much finer. Couple taken!
Fullish on middle and leg, clipped against the spin through mid-wicket. Single taken!
Slow through the air just outside off, Kane looks to loft it downtown but ends up mistiming it over mid on. Has got enough on it to come back for the second.
Tahir fires this one on a good length down the leg side, Taylor stays back to work it through backward square leg for a run.
Fullish ball on middle, eased to mid on for a single.
Fuller length ball in line of the stumps, worked to the leg side for a single.

Morris steams in and bangs in a bouncer outside off, Taylor stands tall and looks to roll his wrists over the pull shot but gets an inside edge onto his pads. The ball towards square leg and he gets a single to his name.
Short of a length outside off, glided down to third man for a run.
On a length angling into  Taylor. He turns it through in front of square for a single.
Back of a length ball well outside off, steered through the vacant gully region for a single.
Starts off with a full toss in his new spell, pushed to the man at short cover off the front foot.
Chris Morris returns for a spell.
Well bowled, Tahir! Slips in the googly outside off, turning in appreciably. Taylor dances down the track and defends it a bit uppishly towards short mid-wicket.
Quicker one on middle, turned through backward square leg for a single.
Fullish delivery on middle and leg, pushed off the front foot to mid on for a single.
Fullish delivery outside off, Ross slices his drive to the man at short third man.
It's been driven superbly through the covers.
Wide! Quicker one on a flatter trajectory but slips it down the leg side, left alone by Taylor.
Tossed up on off, Taylor drives it back to Tahir.
Imran Tahir comes back on.
FOUR! Class! Fractionally overpitched outside off, Kane prods forward and drives it uppishly through mid off and the ball races to the fence.
Shorter length ball wide outside off, Taylor slashes it towards Duminy at backward point who gets a hand to it and takes pace off it. Restricts the batsmen to a single.
Fuller length ball slanting across Taylor. He shuffles across and defends it towards mid off.
Back of a length ball well outside off, glided down to third man for a single.
Similar length ball in line of the stumps, tucked to the leg side for a run.
29th ODI fifty for Kane Williamson!
It has been a free flowing knock from Williamson and very well deserved! On a length on middle and leg, worked calmly through backward square leg for a single.
Dug in short on middle, Williamson pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a single. Moves to 49 from 58 balls.
FOUR! Easy pickings! Andile slips it down on the hips, Williamson gets a fine tickle on it and gets it through fine leg for another boundary.
Phehlukwayo bangs in a bouncer in line of the stumps, Ross pulls it to fine leg. A run taken!
FOUR! Intent from Taylor! Backs away to the fuller length ball on middle and thumps it over covers for a gorgeous boundary.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
Good length delivery on off, Taylor hangs back and defends it towards short mid-wicket.

FOUR! Well played! Short delivery in line of the stumps, Kane stands tall and pulls it nicely through backward square leg. Has struck that well and earns a boundary to his name. Moves to 44 from 56 balls. 10 from that over.
Banged in short again, pulled down to fine leg for a run.
Wide! Short ball down the leg side, Taylor goes for the hook but fails to make any contact.
Fuller length delivery on off, Kane works it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Good channel this from Parnell! Bowls it on a length on middle, seaming away. Taylor is opened up in his stance a bit and gets an outside edge towards the slip region. Single taken!
Fullish delivery outside off, Taylor creams it through covers and gets two runs for doing so.
50-run stand up between Ross Taylor and Kane Williamson!
Shortish delivery in line of the stumps, Taylor gets up on his toes and half pulls it towards square leg for a brisk single.
Full length ball outside off, driven nicely towards covers where Miller makes a good stop.
Full length ball sliding down on the pads, Taylor looks to clip it through but gets an inside edge onto his pads.
Andile bangs in a short ball down the leg side, Kane stands tall and pulls it hard down to fine leg for a run.
Williamson backs away this time and Andile is smart to bowl a good length delivery in line of the stumps. Kane can only place it to the man at point.
This time Williamson camps back to the length delivery and defends it calmly.
Short of a length delivery slanting across Kane. He dabs it towards gully and takes a run for it.
Bowls a short delivery on middle and leg, Williamson sways away from the line and lets it sail through to the keeper. One bouncer for the over called by the umpire.

Good game awareness! Fuller length ball slanting across Taylor. He shuffles across and pushes it down the track. Parnell dives but fails to stop it with a dive. Taylor senses the opportunity and the batsmen come across for a sharp single.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Well bowled! Bowls a good length delivery on off and gets it to move away slightly from Taylor. He shuffles across and has a tame push at it but is beaten all ends up.
Wide! Parnell bangs in a bouncer around leg  stump, Taylor has to sway away from the line of the delivery to evade it. Wide called by the umpire for height.
Comes around the wicket and bowls a fuller length ball on middle, Taylor strides forward and defends it down the pitch.
Wayne Parnell called back on for a bowl.

FOUR! Brilliant! The Kiwi skipper is in great touch! Fuller length ball in line of the stumps, Kane makes room and goes downtown. Strikes it ever so sweetly to send it sailing over mid on and through to the fence.

In the air... but safe! Length delivery around off, seaming in. Taylor in his customary manner comes across but clips it uppishly this time. The ball just flies wide of a diving Amla to his right at short mid-wicket. Single taken!
Fullish delivery shaping back in, Ross comes forward and defends it to mid-wicket.
Fuller length ball around off, Taylor shuffles across and turns it to mid-wicket.
Dug in short on middle, Williamson swivels across and pulls it down through backward square leg. A run taken!
On a length on middle and off, Taylor works it through square leg for a single.
Driven towards the mid on region. They pick up a single.

Loopy ball outside off, Taylor creams it towards covers where Andile dives athletically to his right and makes a great half-stop. He deflects it towards extra cover and the batsmen run a single. Faf rushes to it and while picking it up slips. The batsmen steal another run.
This time Taylor comes forward and plays it to mid-wicket.
FOUR! That's cracked! Loopy ball well outside off, Taylor comes forward and crashes it through covers for a rollicking boundary.
Drags his length back around off, spinning away. Williamson hangs back and  defends it to the on side for a single.
Taylor uses his feet to the tossed up delivery and eases it through mid on. Single taken!
FOUR! Shot! Fuller length ball outside off, Kane lunges forward and lofts it over mid on. Didn't middle it but has enough on it to reach the long on fence.
Kane camps back to the good length ball outside off and dabs it towards the slip region. Wants the single but is sent back by his partner.
Andile bangs this one short on middle, Taylor gets on top of it and plays a controlled pull through backward square leg for a run.
Andile agains hurls in a back of a length ball on off, Kane shuffles across and tucks it through square leg. Single taken!
Bowls a full length ball attacking the stumps, Kane clips it nicely towards short mid-wicket where Amla makes a good diving stop.
Back of a length ball angling into Williamson. He camps back and turns it towards mid-wicket.
Tossed up outside off, Kane drives it with the spin to long off for a run and retains strike.
Taylor dances down the track and takes it on the full to ease it down to long off. A run taken!
Tahir slips in a quicker googly around off, spinning in. Taylor lunges forward and defends it nicely.
Loopy ball around off, driven to mid off.
Tossed up on middle, Williamson defends it solidly towards square leg. Amla rushes after it from leg slip but fails to prevent the single.
Shortish ball outside off, Kane camps back and cuts it  to the man at short cover who makes a good stop.
Andile bangs it short this time on middle and leg, Kane stands tall and pulls it nicely through backward square leg. Single taken!
Straying on the pads, nudged easily through square leg for a run.
On a length shaping in from outside off, Ross covers the line and defends it solidly down the pitch.
Full length ball outside off, Taylor leans forward and drives it crisply to the man at covers.
Good length delivery outside off, Ross shuffles across and dabs it beside the pitch on the off side and looks for a run. However, he is rightly sent back by his skipper, Williamson.
FOUR! Easy pickings! Phehlukwayo slips it on a length on the hips, Taylor shuffles across and gets a fine tickle to it to send it across to the fine leg fence.
Drinks.
Flatter on the stumps, Taylor comes down and works it through mid on for a single.
Floats it outside off, Williamson drives it through extra cover for a single.
Taylor once again paddles it down to fine leg for a single.
This time he gets over it and clips it through mid on for a single.
Fuller outside off, Kane looks to drive but hits it in the air. The ball falls short of the diving short extra cover fielder.
Low full toss outside off, Taylor gets low and paddles it down to fine leg for a run.
Good length on the pads, Taylor looks to clip but misses. The ball goes off the pads towards fine leg for a leg bye.
Shorter length from Andile, pulled through square leg for a single.
Kane clips it through mid-wicket for a single. There is a direct hit at the striker's end and the ricochet gets them another single.
Taylor again plays this length ball in front of his pads, gets it towards mid on and takes the fielder on. The throw at the non-striker's end is a bit wide and he gets back in his crease in time.
Angled on a length on off, Taylor is opened up a touch but does well to defend it from his crease.
Outside off on a length, dabbed through the vacant gully region for a single.
Andile Phehlukwayo is brought on for a bowl now.
Floats it outside off, Taylor turns it towards mid-wicket.
Floats it outside off, Taylor comes forward and defends it watchfully.
Floats it on off, Kane drives it through mid off for a single.
Flatter on the stumps, Taylor clips it off the inner half of the bat through mid-wicket for a single.
Floats it on off, Taylor hits it back to the bowler from his crease.
Worked towards square leg for a single by Kane Williamson.
Ross Taylor comes out to bat.

OUT! Brownlie departs! Fuller in length on the stumps, Brownlie looks to clip it through but misses and is rapped on the pads. The players appeal and the umpire obliges. Brownlie does not even bother with the review as that looked pretty dead to the naked eye. A stand broken just in time for South Africa. Replays though show that it was missing the leg stump. Oh dear!
Angled on the stumps, worked through the same area for another single.
Another pull this time for Brownlie for a single to deep backward square leg.
Shorter length on the stumps, pulled through square leg for a single to Parnell in the deep.
Shot! Fuller outside off, Williamson punches it nicely back to the bowler. The bowler gets to the ball and deflects it towards mid-wicket.
Fuller in length on off, Kane punches it towards mid on who dives to his left and stops the ball. Andile was the fielder there.
Good length on off, punched towards the leg side by Brownlie.
Gets across and paddles it down to fine leg. The fielder does well to stop the ball in time and keeps them to three.
Shorter outside off, Kane looks to smack it through mid-wicket but finds the fielder. That was asking to be hit and the Kiwi skipper will be knowing he missed out on a boundary.
Floats it outside off, Kane Williamson comes forward to defend but the ball beats the outside edge of the bat.
Fuller on middle, Dean works it through mid on for a single.
Shorter outside off, Dean stays back and defends it towards covers.
Time for spin. Imran Tahir is introduced into the attack.
Length around off, Kane comes down to have a go at it but ends up mistiming it towards mid on on the bounce.
On the pads, worked through mid-wicket for a couple of runs. This was superbly timed by Williamson.
On a length on off, Williamson looks to clip it through but the ball comes in sharply and goes off the inner half towards mid on.
Fuller on the stumps, Kane turns it towards mid-wicket from his crease.
Angled on the pads, clipped towards mid-wicket for a single by Brownlie.
FOUR! Top shot! On a length around off, Brownlie punches it back down the wicket through mid on for a boundary. That was superbly timed.
The umpire signals the start of the second Powerplay. Four fielders are allowed outside the 30-yard circle now.
Fuller in length on off, driven to mid on from Kane Williamson.
Williamson stays in his crease and pushes it towards covers.
Bowls it outside off, Williamson is right behind it and defends it.
Shorter outside off, Brownlie controls the bounce on this one and pulls it through square leg for a single.
Fuller outside off, Brownlie plays it towards point off his crease.
Length ball outside off, driven to short extra cover by Dean Brownlie.
On a length on off, Williamson defends it watchfully from his crease.
Shorter ball which is pulled through square leg for a single by Brownlie.
Hurls it outside off, hit on the up towards mid off but not for any runs.
Outside off on a length, Brownlie guides it towards point from his crease.
Angled on the pads, Kane tucks it to fine leg for a single with a neat clip.
Fuller in length on off, Kane pushes it back down the wicket to the bowler.
FOUR! Punished! Short outside off, Dean Brownlie stands tall and smashes it wide of the point fielder for a boundary.
Hurls it on a back of a length around off, Brownlie gets out of the way in time. That was a snorter really.
FOUR! Poor ball and punished! Shorter again, Dean Brownlie gets behind the line and works it through backward square leg for a boundary.
Shorter outside off, left alone by the batsman.
FOUR! Brilliant shot! Outside off, Dean stands tall and crunches this one through extra cover for a boundary.
Slants it on a length just around off, Brownlie looks to defend but the ball hits him high on the bat.
Chris Morris comes back for a bowl.
Fuller on off, defended off the crease towards the on side.
FOUR! Top shot! Outside off on a length, Williamson gets on top of it and punches it through covers for a boundary.
Hurls it outside off, Kane defends it off the inside edge onto his pads. Morris has his hands on his head.
Angled on a length outside off, Brownlie dabs it towards gully and takes off for a single. Amla goes to his right and tries to stop it and manages to do so as well.
Fuller on off, Kane looks to clip but it goes off the inner half through square leg for a single.
On a length outside off, Williamson punches it towards covers from his crease.
Outside off on a length, Dean defends it towards point and wants a single but is sent back.
On a length on off, worked towards square leg by Dean Brownlie.
Angled on a length outside off, Brownlie gets across and pulls it through mid-wicket. Andile gives it a good chase from mid on and keeps them to a couple.
Outside off on a length, Dean punches it towards mid off from his crease.

Oh that's terrible! AB de Villiers is in a lot of discomfort. He has landed heavily on his shoulder while attempting to stop the ball. The physio attends to him and thankfully AB seems to be fine to carry on. There can be nothing worse that can happen to South Africa than AB de Villiers getting injured once again.
Ouch! Fuller outside off, hit towards mid off where AB de Villiers fields the ball and he looks to be in terrible pain as he lands heavily on his shoulder.
Sprayed outside off, left alone by Kane Williamson.
This one is around the stumps, Dean defends it watchfully from his crease.
Bowls it on off, Kane gets an inside edge to the leg side as he looks to defend it from his crease but was beaten by the inswing on that one. He gets off the mark.
Angled it on the pads, Dean looks to work it through but gets it off his pads towards short fine leg. A leg bye taken.
Just around off, Dean mistimes his drive towards mid on.
Fuller on the stumps, worked towards mid-wicket where the fielder makes a good diving stop.
On a length just around off, Dean defends it towards mid-wicket off his back foot.
Dwaine Pretorius comes into the attack. Meanwhile, AB de Villiers is still having issues with his left hand and gets it taped.
On a length just around off, Kane defends it watchfully but still gets an inside edge onto his pads. The ball rolls towards the off side but they do not go for any runs.

JUST SHORT! Parnell bowls it outside off, Kane feels at it from his crease. The ball goes off the outside edge and just drops short of Faf du Plessis at second slip who dives to his right but cannot get to the ball.
Slanted outside off, left alone by Kane Williamson.
New Zealand skipper, Kane Williamson strides out to bat.

OUT! Easy as you like! Parnell bowls it on the pads, it is there to be hit but Latham hits it too well and finds Andile Phehlukwayo at mid-wicket who takes a simple catch. That is as soft a dismissal possible.
Back of a length just around off, Latham defends it towards the off side with an angled bat.
Fuller ball angling into the stumps, Latham clips it through mid-wicket for a couple of runs.
AB de Villiers gets some medical attention on his left hand.
FOUR! Top shot! Fuller outside off, Dean gets on top of it and crashes it through extra cover for a boundary.
On a length on off, Dean looks to defend but gets hit higher on his bat. The ball rolls towards square leg.
FOUR! Nicely done! On a length on off, Dean gets over it nicely and works it through square leg for a boundary. First boundary of the game!
Slapped but good stop! Shorter outside off, Dean gets on top of it and crunches it towards covers where Miller makes a terrific stop.
Hurls it around off, hit back to the bowler by Dean. Morris goes to his right and mimes the throw. Good aggression shown as Dean had to hurry back into his crease.
Fuller outside off, Brownlie pushes it through covers but not in the gap.
Outside off, Latham presses forward and pushes it towards cover-point.
EDGED! Slanted across on a length, Brownlie is not in line of this one and looks to work it through mid on. The ball flies off the outside edge behind backward point for a single.
On a length outside off, worked through mid-wicket.
Shorter outside off, Brownlie rides the bounce and tucks it towards mid-wicket from his crease.
Wide outside off, left alone by Dean Brownlie.
Indecision! Slanted across on a length, Brownlie wants to leave it but ends up playing at it before withdrawing his bat. The ball runs off the face of the bat towards the slip cordon.
Wayne Parnell to bowl with the second new ball from the other end.
Slanted way outside off, Latham has an easy leave to offer.
Outside off going further away, left alone by Tom Latham.
First runs! Fuller on off, Brownlie looks to defend but gets it off the inner half towards square leg for a single.
On a length around off, Brownlie defends it watchfully from his crease.
Fuller and slanting on the pads, Brownlie fails to clip it through and is hit on his pads.
Shorter outside off, Brownlie mistimes his punch towards covers from his crease.
WIDE! Short and wide outside off, left alone by Brownlie. The umpire signals it a wide.
The players are out in the middle. Dean Brownlie and Tom Latham are the two openers for the hosts. South Africa begin with Chris Morris! He has a couple of slips in place for him. Here we go...

TOSS - South Africa win the toss and elect to field first! Three changes for them, David Miller in for Farhaan Behardien, Wayne Parnell comes in for Kagiso Rabada and Dwaine Pretorius replaces Tabraiz Shamsi. The hosts are unchanged from the last game.

The visitors on the other hand are sitting pretty in the series with a 1-0 lead but will know that they almost messed up a routine chase in the previous encounter. They will want to ensure it is not repeated ahead as the Kiwis are not a side that often repeat their mistakes. The Proteas have their own fair share of areas to work on and their skipper, AB de Villiers will hope they can put in a complete performance to win their 13th ODI game in a row - a new record for them.

Hello everyone and welcome to the coverage of the 2nd of the five-match ODI series at the Hagley Oval, Christchurch. The hosts having lost the only T20I and the thriller in the first ODI will be itching to make a comeback in this game. Kane Williamson will know his top order has been faulty and in the absence of Martin Guptill, they have been found wanting. Ross Taylor will once again be expected to guide this young side forward with the bat.
